title: Havenline Resource Turnaround Renders
requested: All resource materials, 360 view; explicitly wood, stone, slate, steel, fuel, meat, fish, etc.
deliverable: Separate stylized concept turnaround sheets for material and support-resource inventory. These are concept images, not proof of implemented 3D meshes.
workflow: independent visual review of actual images

checks.text: All seven explicit user resources receive distinct sheets.
All identified project resource inventory covered; support props distinguished.
Each sheet shows front, front-right, right, rear-right, rear, rear-left, left, front-left views around same object, plus top if useful.
Havenline stylized chunky forms, rounded edges, broad sculpted details, clear materials; actual project reference pixels used.
Matching objects within sheet: geometry, parts, paint, knots, straps, contents and arrangement stable through view changes.
Material silhouettes distinct, objects fully framed, clean dark navy background, readable angle labels.
Independent critic inspects generated images; pass strictly >9.0 with no failed mandatory check, or preserve honest defects.
Do not imply generated images are native mesh renders, implemented game assets, user-approved production art or executable rotations.
Preserve original approved work; new images saved as separate proposed design references and checkpoint.

sources.primary_pending: 18607.png and 18600.png (newest user Havenline boards identified by project reference authority)
sources.secondary: Whiteout Survival Asset Reference Guide.png and original A/B reference video frames

limitations: No recovered distinct approved resource designs for slate, steel or meat yet; current request authorizes concept designs within established art direction.
Generated view sheets can show a turnaround concept but do not demonstrate geometrically exact 3D assets or runtime behavior.
next_action: Inspect primary source boards, then generate the first three resources.
